goalbuddy_receipt_v1.rationale: The merged manual editor has a viable local-first integration boundary: the existing loopback API can own authenticated ingress, delivery, acknowledgements, and idempotency; a strict shared protocol can validate transactions; and the client can stage changes on a detached SVG clone before committing through SvgEditor’s snapshot/history path. Sequential T002-T006 slices are safe with the refinements below. Two fidelity conflicts must be corrected: loading currently removes root width/height, and saving injects metadata#lineage-logo-edit, both contrary to the new clean-faithful-export oracle. Agent SVG must be rejected, never silently sanitized, when active/external content or reference damage is detected.

evidence.finding: origin/main is ef24a00, merging 6581ced; HEAD is the merged feature commit and has an identical tree to origin/main. Local main is stale at d940ac5 but does not affect this read-only validation.

Use the existing loopback Node server, not new infrastructure. src/server/index.ts:15,100-153 already binds 127.0.0.1, owns /api routes, workspace scope, JSON parsing, CSP, and static production hosting; vite.config.ts:16-22 already proxies /api in development; scripts/dev.ts:32-58 already coordinates dynamic API/editor ports and lifecycle. Add transport within this boundary, factoring route/state logic into an importable server module.

Keep SvgEditor authoritative for the accepted document, selection, dirty state, and history. src/client/canvas/editor.ts:521-536 initializes the canonical SVG and session keys; 653-684 owns undo/redo/reset/clean serialization; 1023-1069 centralizes checkpoints and document notifications; 1304-1359 snapshots/restores markup, scope, primary selection, and multi-selection. Do not let transport or the adapter mutate DOM directly.

src/client/history/history.ts:1-38 stores opaque snapshots and already supports a transaction-sized checkpoint. A staged candidate can therefore remain outside history, acceptance can checkpoint once, and revert can discard without a history entry. Revision must be a separate monotonic concurrency token because restoring an older snapshot must not roll revision backward.

src/client/canvas/editor.ts:852-868 assigns unique session-only data-lineage-key values and serializeSvg strips data-lineage attributes at 127-158. Publish these keys in an authenticated current-document manifest and use them as transaction targets; never require persistent SVG IDs and never export keys.

Protocol v1 envelope: {protocolVersion:1, transactionId, producer:{kind,name,version?}, document:{sessionId,sourcePath,baseRevision}, operations:[...]}. Require strict fields, transaction/operation IDs of bounded length, 1-100 operations, and <=5 MiB encoded payload. LayerRef is either {sessionKey} or {operationId} referencing an earlier structural operation. Operations are addLayer(parent,placement,svg), replaceLayer(target,svg), renameLayer(target,name|null), reorderLayer(target,before|after sibling), setPaint(target,fill|stroke,value|null), and selectFocus(targets,primary?,scope?). Unknown versions, operations, fields, forward references, missing/ambiguous targets, invalid placement, and all-no-op mutating transactions are structured rejections.

Parse and apply operations sequentially to a detached clone of the current accepted SVG. Each structural operation yields a transaction-local result reference. Validate the complete candidate, IDs, local references, locks, resulting selection, and byte limit before exposing a preview. Any failure discards the clone and returns {transactionId,status:'rejected',error:{code,message,operationId?,path?}} with no document, selection, revision, dirty, or history mutation. Success returns an impact manifest keyed by operationId and affected session keys. Mutating transactions become pending_review; navigation-only selectFocus transactions may apply immediately without revision/history.

Each file load creates a new document sessionId at revision 0. Every canonical manual mutation, accepted agent transaction, undo, redo, or content-changing reset increments revision monotonically once; preview/revert/navigation do not. Delivery must match sessionId, sourcePath, and exact baseRevision at the client. Permit only one pending mutating transaction; freeze document-mutating controls while pending. Accept checkpoints the pre-accept editor snapshot once, commits the whole candidate, applies requested focus, marks dirty, and increments revision once. Revert discards preview, restores exact pre-preview context, creates no history entry, and leaves revision/dirty unchanged. Undo after accept restores the pre-accept SVG and selection and increments revision; redo likewise.

Use POST /api/agent/transactions for bearer-authenticated producer submission, GET /api/agent/document for the authenticated current manifest, GET /api/agent/events as the same-origin SSE stream, browser acknowledgement/state endpoints protected by exact editor origin, and authenticated GET status for producers. Store transactionId plus payload hash and lifecycle state in a bounded in-memory registry. Exact duplicates return prior status without delivery; same ID with different bytes returns id_conflict. SSE uses monotonic event IDs, Last-Event-ID replay, heartbeat, a bounded backlog, 15-second delivery/staging timeout, and terminal states pending_review/accepted/reverted/rejected/stale/disconnected. Reconnect may resume undelivered events but must never redeliver terminal/applied transactions.

Generate a high-entropy bearer token at local server startup or accept an explicit environment/CLI token; print it for the adapter, never place it in URLs or browser state, compare it safely, bind only loopback, require application/json, and emit no CORS allowance. Browser stream/ack routes require the dynamically configured editor origin; vite.config.ts:20 must stop hard-coding port 5173. Treat all agent SVG as untrusted. Parse as SVG XML and reject the entire transaction for parser errors, multiple fragment roots, script, foreignObject, SMIL animation, event handlers, style elements/attributes in the MVP, external href/src/url, unsupported namespaces, or over-limit content. Never strip or normalize rejected content silently.

For add/replace, require exactly one selectable top-level layer, while allowing safe unsupported descendants/resources to round-trip. Newly introduced IDs must not create collisions; newly introduced #references must resolve exactly once in the candidate; replacing/removing IDs referenced outside the targeted subtree is rejected unless the replacement preserves those IDs. Existing untouched duplicate IDs or unsupported constructs are preserved rather than globally rewritten. setPaint accepts null/inherited or validated SVG paint and permits url(#id) only when the local target resolves exactly once. Locked targets or descendants are rejected; hidden targets may be staged and must remain locatable in review.
